**Municipal laws, newest first.** Each law the Câmara's SAPL lists with a PDF that has a text layer of its own, as enacted, credited to itself. Laws are added in parts, working back in time; later amendments by other laws are not worked into earlier laws. Scans and laws that take effect on another day than their publication are left out.

State law is in [brazil-minas-gerais-law](https://github.com/lexifina/brazil-minas-gerais-law); federal law is in [brazil-law](https://github.com/lexifina/brazil-law).
dates: Each law is dated by the publication date SAPL records for it (else by its own date), and only laws whose own vigência clause says they take effect on their publication (or signature) are taken in (Decreto-Lei 4.657/1942, art. 1, would otherwise give 45 days). Commits are at noon in Lavras.
built: Each law's PDF is read from its heading to the closing line that ends in its date (signatures after it are left out); lines repeated at the top or bottom of two or more pages and page numbers are left out; lines are joined into paragraphs, one file per Art.
limits: The record is SAPL's: a version is only as exact as the Câmara's text for it. Only the newest laws are in so far; older ones follow in later parts. The text is not the official version: only the Diário Oficial do Município is authoritative.
